items.title: Accor’s Largest Shareholder Moves to Oust CEO After Ennismore Buyout
items.why: A leadership fight at a major hotel loyalty owner could shift partner priorities, so confirm the outcome before negotiating.
items.summary_ai: Activist investor Parvus wants Accor's CEO removed, citing the Ennismore buyout and years of share underperformance.
items.take: A leadership fight at a major hotel loyalty owner could shift partner priorities, so confirm the outcome before negotiating.
